name: The Rose Manor
source:
What seemed like the simple beginning of a new chapter in Angela's life may end up being the greatest challenge she's ever faced.

Is she truly ready for what awaits her?

Who can she truly trust?

Who will be by her side... and who is secretly her enemy?

[From [url=https://a-little-love.itch.io/the-rose-manor]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
原本看似只是安吉拉人生新篇章的寻常开端，或许终将成为她有生以来面临的最大考验。

对于前方等待着的一切，她真的做好准备了吗？

她究竟能真正信任谁？

谁会陪伴在她身旁……而谁又是暗藏在身边的敌人？

[摘自[url=https://a-little-love.itch.io/the-rose-manor]Itch.io[/url]]
